document_metadata.summary: Jane Foster and Erik Selvig await a celestial event in the desert, emotionally reflecting on her late mentor as they prepare to observe the anomaly with improvised equipment.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor's comrades gather in a festive hall; Volstagg is hungry, Fandral jests, Hogun remains grim, and Sif silences Fandral's bravado with wit.

entities.name: Thor demands retribution from the Jotuns
entities.description: Thor declares that the Jotuns must pay for their intrusion and the destruction they caused in the Vault.

entities.name: Odin confirms the Jotuns have been defeated and the Casket is secure
entities.description: Odin states that the Jotuns have already paid with their lives, the Destroyer has fulfilled its duty, and the Casket is safe, bringing closure to the incident.

entities.name: Aftermath Inspection Of The Vault Breach
entities.description: A group of Asgardians, including Thor, Sif, the Warriors Three, and Odin, gather in the Vault following a violent intrusion by Frost Giants to assess the damage and confirm the security of the Casket of Ancient Winters.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: A powerful Asgardian warrior who reacts with shock and anger upon seeing the aftermath of the battle in the Vault.
entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Lady Sif
entities.description: An Asgardian warrior who enters the Vault with Thor and recognizes the Destroyer.
entities.summary: A warrior woman and companion of Thor, clad in ceremonial armor, participates in key Asgardian events, expressing sentiment toward her weapons, reacting to threats, and investigating disruptions alongside the Warriors Three and Thor.

entities.name: Fandral
entities.description: A member of the Warriors Three who expresses discomfort at being inside the Vault.
entities.summary: A charismatic member of the Warriors Three, known for his dashing demeanor and agility, who accompanies Thor and others on missions, expresses concern over legal and dangerous consequences, and makes light-hearted comments in tense situations.

entities.name: Volstagg
entities.description: A member of the Warriors Three who is awed by the sight of the Destroyer and questions the existence of the Tesseract.
entities.summary: A large, bearded warrior and member of the Warriors Three, known for his strength, love of food, and loyalty to Thor, expresses awe at powerful artifacts and concern for his comrades while sharing in grand events and battles.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: A cunning Asgardian who enters the Vault with Thor and the others, observing the aftermath in silence.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Odin Allfather
entities.description: The Allfather of Asgard who arrives to assess the destruction and confirms the Jotuns have been defeated.
entities.summary: The Allfather, king of Asgard and father of Thor and Loki, embodies authority and concern over Thor's readiness for kingship, judging his actions and emphasizing responsibility while exhibiting signs of physical decline.

entities.name: Frost Giants
entities.summary: Ice giants from Jotunheim, blue-skinned and powerful, are enemies of Asgard, engaged in conflict due to historical grievances and perceived threats of invasion, retreating at Odin's presence.

entities.name: Casket Of Ancient Winters
entities.description: A powerful artifact that was targeted by the Jotuns and is kept secure in the Vault.
entities.summary: A powerful artifact stolen by Odin from the Frost Giants, sought by Laufey and the Jotuns for war, was retrieved from the Vault but is now missing after a failed Asgard incursion.

entities.name: Destroyer
entities.description: A black metal automaton imbued with immense power, capable of defending the Vault by annihilating intruders.
entities.summary: A powerful, autonomous black metal automaton armed with energy-based weapons, housed in the Vault and activated when threatened, moves independently to eliminate intruders, perceived as hostile and currently being distracted by the Warriors Three.

entities.name: Warriors Three
entities.summary: Asgardian warriors Fandral, Volstagg, Hogun, and Sif accompany Thor or react during key events, showing surprise at Loki on the throne and Laufey's claims, while present at the coronation amid a mysterious cold.

entities.name: Tesseract
entities.description: A legendary cosmic artifact once believed to have been stored in the Vault, associated with great power and mystery.
entities.summary: A legendary cosmic artifact once believed to have been stored in the Vault, associated with great power and mystery.

entities.name: Thor confronts Odin about the Frost Giants' breach of the Vault
entities.description: Thor challenges Odin's assessment of the situation, arguing that the Frost Giants' intrusion into the Weapons Vault constitutes an act of war and demands aggressive retaliation.

entities.name: Odin asserts authority over Thor and dismisses his comrades
entities.description: Odin interrupts Thor's demands, orders Sif and the Warriors Three to leave, and directly questions Thor's judgment, reinforcing his role as king and father.

entities.name: Thor demands military action against Jotunheim
entities.description: Thor proposes leading an invasion of Jotunheim to punish the Frost Giants and prevent future threats by breaking their spirits through force.

entities.name: Odin rejects Thor's warrior mindset and emphasizes measured response
entities.description: Odin criticizes Thor for thinking only as a warrior, downplays the incident as the failed act of a few individuals, and commits to securing Asgard's defenses instead of retaliating.

entities.name: Thor storms out of the Vault after being denied leadership authority
entities.description: Realizing he has lost the argument and been reminded he is not yet king, Thor angrily exits the Vault, slamming the doors behind him in frustration.

entities.name: Weapons Vault
entities.description: A specific interior chamber in Asgard where powerful relics are stored, serving as the setting for the confrontation between Thor and Odin.

entities.name: Laufey
entities.description: The Jotun King who has a truce with Odin but is believed to have broken it by attempting to reclaim the Casket of Ancient Winters.
entities.summary: The Jotun King, ruler of Jotunheim and Loki's biological father, confronts Odin over the Casket of Ancient Winters, accused of breaking their truce while seeking to reclaim it and awaken dormant Frost Giants.

document_metadata.title: 28、INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor and Loki, joined by the Warriors Three and Sif, resolve to go to Jotunheim together despite the dangers, defying Asgard's laws.

entities.name: Thor overturns banquet table in anger
entities.description: Thor, filled with anger and frustration over the cancellation of his triumph, flips over a massive banquet table in the empty hall.

entities.name: Loki observes Thor from across the hall
entities.description: Loki silently watches Thor's outburst from the opposite side of the banquet hall, remaining calm as tension builds.

entities.name: Sif, Fandral, Hogun, and Volstagg enter the banquet hall
entities.description: Sif, Fandral, Hogun, and Volstagg follow Volstagg into the banquet hall, where they discover the overturned tables and scattered food.

entities.name: Volstagg expresses grief over wasted food
entities.description: Volstagg laments the spilled food and ruined feast, mourning the loss as if it were a tragic event.

entities.name: Thor confronts Loki about the cancelled celebration
entities.description: Thor tells Loki that the banquet hall was meant to host his day of triumph, expressing his disappointment and sense of injustice.

entities.name: Loki admits agreement with Thor's concerns about Frost Giants
entities.description: Loki concedes that Thor was right about the Frost Giants' threat and the vulnerability of Asgard's defenses.

entities.name: Thor decides to travel to Jotunheim for Asgard's safety
entities.description: After considering the threat, Thor declares his intention to go to Jotunheim to protect Asgard, despite the risks of defying Odin.

entities.name: Loki attempts to dissuade Thor from going to Jotunheim
entities.description: Loki recognizes Thor's determined expression and warns him that the plan is madness, trying to stop him from taking reckless action.

document_metadata.title: 28、INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor and Loki, joined by the Warriors Three and Sif, resolve to go to Jotunheim together despite the dangers, defying Asgard's laws.

entities.name: Thor convinces his friends to journey to Jotunheim
entities.description: Thor uses his charisma and shared history with his companions to persuade them to join him in defying Asgardian law by traveling to Jotunheim in search of answers.

entities.name: Loki observes Thor's persuasion attempt with intrigue
entities.description: Loki silently watches Thor rally his friends, showing quiet interest in the unfolding defiance of Asgardian law.

entities.name: Thor recounts past adventures to strengthen his argument
entities.description: Thor reminds his companions of their shared exploits, including introducing Fandral to exotic maidens, leading Hogun into battle, and supporting Sif's rise as a warrior, to reinforce their loyalty.

entities.name: Thor's companions reluctantly agree to join the forbidden mission
entities.description: After exchanging concerned glances and recognizing Thor's determination, Fandral, Volstagg, Hogun, and Sif accept they cannot dissuade him and decide to accompany him to Jotunheim.

entities.name: Jotunheim
entities.description: A forbidden realm and physical location central to the discussion, representing a distinct and named setting in the narrative.
entities.summary: A forbidden, extremely cold realm central to the narrative, serving as a dangerous wasteland where Thor's group is located and where sustained Bifrost activation would cause destruction; it is the origin of the Casket and where Odin found infant Loki.

entities.name: Asgard
entities.description: A named realm and setting, referenced as the origin of the characters and the authority whose laws they are considering breaking.
entities.summary: Asgard is the realm and capital city of the Asgardians, serving as the origin and authority for its characters, and the setting for key events such as royal ceremonies, from which Thor and companions depart through the Gate.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: A named realm and physical location where Thor previously summoned lightning and thunder, mentioned as a point of comparison to the current mission.
entities.summary:
The planet Earth, presented as the physical setting where humanity resides and from which the cosmic perspective begins.
A named realm and physical location where Thor previously summoned lightning and thunder, mentioned as a point of comparison to the current mission.

entities.name: Yggdrasil
entities.summary: The Worlds Tree is a cosmic structure in Asgardian cosmology linking the Nine Realms, symbolizing the unity of science and magic through its branching pathways.

entities.name: Valhalla
entities.description: A named and specific afterlife realm in Norse cosmology, mentioned as a destination associated with glorious battle and divine reward.
entities.summary: A named and specific afterlife realm in Norse cosmology, mentioned as a destination associated with glorious battle and divine reward.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: A powerful Asgardian warrior who seeks to journey to Jotunheim to find answers, using his charisma and shared history to persuade his companions.
entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: Thor's brother who observes the persuasion attempt with quiet intrigue, showing interest in the unfolding events.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Fandral
entities.description: One of Thor's companions and a warrior of Asgard, who expresses concern over the danger of violating the law by going to Jotunheim.
entities.summary: A charismatic member of the Warriors Three, known for his dashing demeanor and agility, who accompanies Thor and others on missions, expresses concern over legal and dangerous consequences, and makes light-hearted comments in tense situations.

entities.name: Lady Sif
entities.description: A fierce Asgardian warrior and companion of Thor who initially resists the idea of the forbidden journey but is reminded of Thor's past support.
entities.summary: A warrior woman and companion of Thor, clad in ceremonial armor, participates in key Asgardian events, expressing sentiment toward her weapons, reacting to threats, and investigating disruptions alongside the Warriors Three and Thor.

entities.name: Volstagg
entities.description: A loyal companion of Thor known for his love of food and battle, who acknowledges Thor's leadership in past adventures.
entities.summary: A large, bearded warrior and member of the Warriors Three, known for his strength, love of food, and loyalty to Thor, expresses awe at powerful artifacts and concern for his comrades while sharing in grand events and battles.

entities.name: Hogun
entities.description: A serious and loyal warrior among Thor's companions who, like the others, is swayed by Thor's appeal to their shared history.
entities.summary: A stoic, brooding warrior of the Warriors Three, loyal to Thor, notices Loki's absence, predicts the banquet's cancellation, and expresses concern over their presence in the Jotun wasteland.

entities.name: Casket Of Ancient Winters
entities.description: A powerful artifact taken from Jotunheim by Thor's father after defeating the Frost Giants, symbolizing Asgard's victory and a key reason for Thor's interest in returning to Jotunheim.
entities.summary: A powerful Asgardian artifact from Jotunheim, taken after the Frost Giants' defeat, symbolizes Asgard's victory and triggers Loki's transformation, revealing his heritage while capable of unleashing extreme cold.

entities.name: Frost Giants
entities.description: A race of powerful beings from Jotunheim, enemies of Asgard, whose territory is considered forbidden and extremely dangerous to enter.
entities.summary: Ice giants from Jotunheim, blue-skinned and powerful, are enemies of Asgard, engaged in conflict due to historical grievances and perceived threats of invasion, retreating at Odin's presence.

entities.name: Loki agrees to accompany Thor on the journey to Jotunheim
entities.description: After initially appearing startled, Loki declares his intention to join Thor's mission to Jotunheim, vowing not to let his brother face the journey alone.

entities.name: The Warriors Three pledge to stand by Thor in the mission to Jotunheim

entities.name: Sif expresses concern about the consequences of the mission to Jotunheim

entities.name: Volstagg adds grim humor to the group's commitment with a conditional hope
entities.description: Volstagg responds to Sif's concern by remarking that they will only live to regret the mission if they are lucky, underscoring the peril they anticipate.

document_metadata.title: 37、EXT. CENTRAL PLAZA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor, realizing his actions endangered his comrades, summons the winds to reach them as they're trapped in icy fog on cracking ice, with Frost Giants advancing.

entities.name: Asgardians arrive at the plaza and are surrounded by Frost Giants
entities.description: The Asgardian party enters the plaza and immediately senses Frost Giants hidden in the shadows and crevices, who encircle them on all sides, creating a tense standoff.

entities.name: Jotun Sentry confronts Thor with a demand for explanation
entities.description: A Frost Giant sentry addresses Thor, challenging the Asgardians' presence and demanding to know their purpose in Jotunheim.

entities.name: Thor demands to speak only with Laufey, the Jotun King
entities.description: Thor refuses to engage with the Jotun Sentry, asserting that he will only communicate with King Laufey, not his subordinates.

entities.name: Laufey reveals himself and questions Thor's intrusion
entities.description: From a balcony behind a waterfall, Laufey emerges from the shadows and challenges Thor, acknowledging his identity and accusing him of bringing conflict into their realm.

entities.name: Thor demands answers about Frost Giants' infiltration of Asgard
entities.description: Thor confronts Laufey, demanding an explanation for how the Frost Giants were able to enter Asgard, escalating the tension between the two leaders.

entities.name: Laufey accuses Odin of theft and murder
entities.description: Laufey counters Thor's accusations by denouncing Odin as a murderer and thief who stole from the Jotuns and destroyed their world, justifying their desire to reclaim the Casket.

entities.name: Thor rejects Laufey's justification for using the Casket in war
entities.description: Thor argues that the Frost Giants cannot reclaim the Casket if their intent is to wage war against other Realms, drawing a moral line against their ambitions.

entities.name: Laufey mocks Thor's desire for battle and questions his maturity
entities.description: Laufey ridicules Thor, claiming he does not seek peace but craves battle to prove himself, dismissing him as an immature boy pretending to be a man.

entities.name: Thor advances toward Laufey and is blocked by Frost Giants
entities.description: Provoked by Laufey's taunts, Thor steps forward aggressively, prompting nearby Frost Giants to move in and physically block his path.

entities.name: Loki urges Thor to retreat due to overwhelming odds
entities.description: Loki warns Thor that they are outnumbered and advises immediate withdrawal, appealing to reason amid rising hostilities.

entities.name: Laufey warns Thor of consequences if he continues
entities.description: Laufey cautions Thor that his actions could unleash catastrophic forces, asserting that he is allowing the Asgardians to leave only by his own restraint.

entities.name: Thor reluctantly agrees to withdraw from the confrontation
entities.description: After a tense standoff, Thor chooses not to escalate further, turns away, and begins to leave the plaza with his companions.

entities.name: Loki accepts Laufey's offer to depart peacefully
entities.description: Loki formally acknowledges Laufey's permission to leave, signaling Asgardian acceptance of the truce and de-escalating the situation on behalf of the group.

entities.name: Confrontation At The Jotunheim Temple Plaza
entities.description: A high-tension diplomatic and military encounter between Thor's Asgardian party and the Frost Giants, led by King Laufey, occurring in a sacred plaza, involving verbal challenges, accusations, and a near-violent escalation.
entities.summary: A high-tension diplomatic and military encounter between Thor's Asgardian party and the Frost Giants, led by King Laufey, occurring in a sacred plaza, involving verbal challenges, accusations, and a near-violent escalation.

document_metadata.title: 37、EXT. CENTRAL PLAZA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor, realizing his actions endangered his comrades, summons the winds to reach them as they're trapped in icy fog on cracking ice, with Frost Giants advancing.

entities.name: Thor defeats another Frost Giant
entities.description: Thor successfully takes down an additional Frost Giant during the battle, escalating the conflict between the Asgardians and the Jotuns.

entities.name: Asgardians and Jotuns engage in full-scale battle
entities.description: The confrontation between the Asgardians and the Frost Giants erupts into chaotic combat after initial skirmishes.

entities.name: Hogun dodges ice blade attack and反击s with mace
entities.description: Hogun is cornered by a Frost Giant against an ice wall, evades a deadly strike by swinging his mace into the wall and leaping over the attacker, then defeats two Giants in quick succession.

entities.name: Sif fights off multiple Jotuns with staff
entities.description: Sif skillfully uses her double-bladed staff to stab several Frost Giants one after another during the battle.

entities.name: Sif is knocked to the ground and retaliates
entities.description: After being violently thrown down by a Frost Giant, Sif declares she won't act like a lady if not treated as one, then defeats the attacker.

entities.name: Loki uses illusion to trick and kill a Frost Giant
entities.description: Loki appears trapped at a crevasse edge, but a decoy illusion fools a Frost Giant; the real Loki emerges from hiding and shoves the Giant into the chasm.

entities.name: Loki throws daggers to kill two approaching Jotuns
entities.description: As two Frost Giants attack Loki from both sides, he swiftly throws two daggers, felling both enemies simultaneously.

entities.name: ice wall
entities.description: A wall made of ice that Hogun uses for defense and maneuvering during combat.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: A powerful Asgardian warrior who confidently defeats Frost Giants and leads the battle against the Jotuns.
entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Fandral
entities.description: An Asgardian warrior who discusses battle strategies with Volstagg and Hogun during the fight.
entities.summary: A charismatic member of the Warriors Three, known for his dashing demeanor and agility, who accompanies Thor and others on missions, expresses concern over legal and dangerous consequences, and makes light-hearted comments in tense situations.

entities.name: Volstagg
entities.description: A large Asgardian warrior who suggests using specific combat maneuvers during the battle with the Jotuns.
entities.summary: A large, bearded warrior and member of the Warriors Three, known for his strength, love of food, and loyalty to Thor, expresses awe at powerful artifacts and concern for his comrades while sharing in grand events and battles.

entities.name: Hogun
entities.description: A grim and skilled Asgardian warrior who fights off multiple Frost Giants using his mace and acrobatic moves.
entities.summary: A stoic, brooding warrior of the Warriors Three, loyal to Thor, notices Loki's absence, predicts the banquet's cancellation, and expresses concern over their presence in the Jotun wasteland.

entities.name: Lady Sif
entities.description: A skilled female Asgardian warrior who fights Jotuns with a double-bladed staff and responds defiantly when knocked down.
entities.summary: A warrior woman and companion of Thor, clad in ceremonial armor, participates in key Asgardian events, expressing sentiment toward her weapons, reacting to threats, and investigating disruptions alongside the Warriors Three and Thor.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: A cunning Asgardian who uses illusions to deceive and kill Frost Giants, then eliminates them with daggers.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Frost Giant
entities.description: A large, ice-based humanoid enemy of the Asgardians who engages in combat using ice blades and brute strength.

entities.name: Jotun
entities.description: A member of a race of giants at war with the Asgardians, participating in close combat during the battle.

entities.name: Mace
entities.description: A heavy bludgeoning weapon used by Hogun to fight and defeat multiple Jotuns in battle.
entities.summary: A heavy bludgeoning weapon used by Hogun to fight and defeat multiple Jotuns in battle.

entities.name: Double-Bladed Staff
entities.description: A melee weapon wielded by Sif, used to stab and defeat several Jotuns in combat.
entities.summary: A melee weapon wielded by Sif, used to stab and defeat several Jotuns in combat.

entities.name: Dual Daggers
entities.description: Bladed weapons thrown by Loki to kill two approaching Jotuns during the battle.
entities.summary: Bladed weapons thrown by Loki to kill two approaching Jotuns during the battle.

entities.description: A named combat maneuver suggested by Volstagg for use against the Jotuns in close combat.

entities.description: A suggested battle move mentioned by Volstagg, implying a humorous or unorthodox fighting strategy.

entities.name: Laufey signals guard to attack
entities.description: Laufey nods to one of his guards, a massive Jotun Brute, initiating an aggressive action against the Asgardians.

entities.description: The Jotun Brute jumps from the balcony, coats himself in ice, and punches the ground, causing explosive pillars of ice to launch forward and send Hogun flying.

entities.name: Thor defeats several Jotuns and taunts them
entities.description: Thor effortlessly kills multiple Jotuns and challenges them to provide a greater fight, expressing enjoyment in combat.

entities.name: Jotun Brute lands powerful blow on Thor
entities.description: The massive Jotun Brute strikes Thor with great force, sending him sliding backward across the icy surface.

entities.name: Thor throws Mjolnir and knocks down Jotun Brute
entities.description: Thor hurls Mjolnir with full strength, striking the Brute and causing him to fall head over heels.

entities.name: Mjolnir returns to Thor's hand mid-air
entities.description: After being thrown, Mjolnir slows in flight and reverses direction, returning to Thor’s outstretched hand through his command.

entities.name: Thor mocks defeated Jotun Brute
entities.description: After defeating the Brute, Thor insults him, calling him 'ugly and stupid' as he lies fallen on the ice.

entities.name: Sif is knocked down by Frost Giant while fighting
entities.description: After defeating a couple of Frost Giants, Sif is overpowered and knocked to the ground by another attacker.

entities.name: Hogun throws hidden knife to save Sif
entities.description: Seeing Sif in danger, Hogun draws a concealed knife from his sleeve and throws it accurately into the chest of her attacker, killing him.

entities.name: Sif expresses gratitude for Hogun's knife-throwing skill
entities.description: Sif acknowledges Hogun’s action by remarking that she is glad she taught him how to throw the knife effectively.

entities.name: Volstagg fights Frost Giant and delivers verbal taunt
entities.description: Volstagg exchanges blows with a Frost Giant and mocks him by suggesting he should treat his injuries.

entities.name: Volstagg fends off second Jotun and releases first
entities.description: While engaged with one Frost Giant, Volstagg defends against a second attacker from behind, then releases his initial opponent.

entities.name: Volstagg uses belly attack to send Jotun flying
entities.description: Volstagg launches his large body forward, using his belly as a weapon to knock the Jotun backward with great force.

document_metadata.title: 37、EXT. CENTRAL PLAZA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor, realizing his actions endangered his comrades, summons the winds to reach them as they're trapped in icy fog on cracking ice, with Frost Giants advancing.

entities.name: Jotun grabs Volstagg and slams him to the ground
entities.description: A Frost Giant seizes Volstagg and violently throws him down, initiating physical combat between them.

entities.name: Volstagg warns Frost Giant to surrender
entities.description: While being held by a Jotun, Volstagg issues a verbal warning urging the Frost Giant to give up the fight.

entities.name: Volstagg recovers and continues fighting
entities.description: After being thrown down, Volstagg regains his footing and re-enters the battle against the Frost Giants.

entities.name: Jotun's touch freezes and necrotizes Volstagg's arm
entities.description: A Frost Giant grasps Volstagg's bare arm, causing his skin to rapidly freeze and turn black, leading to tissue necrosis.

entities.name: Volstagg head-butts the Frost Giant
entities.description: In response to being attacked, Volstagg head-butts the Jotun, shattering its ice helmet and knocking it down.

entities.name: Volstagg rests on fallen Jotun's body
entities.description: Exhausted from combat, Volstagg sits on the corpse of a defeated Frost Giant to recover his breath.

entities.name: Volstagg retrieves flask from secret compartment
entities.description: Volstagg opens a concealed compartment in his weapon and removes a small flask containing a drink.

entities.name: Volstagg drinks from flask to relieve pain
entities.description: After seeing the damage to his arm, Volstagg consumes a portion of liquid from the flask, momentarily easing his suffering.

entities.name: Volstagg warns comrades about Frost Giant touch
entities.description: Volstagg shouts a warning to his allies, urging them to avoid physical contact with the Frost Giants.

entities.name: Volstagg stabs Frost Giant but blade gets stuck
entities.description: Volstagg thrusts his sword into a Frost Giant's chest, but the blade halts within the ice layer of its body.

entities.name: Frost Giant strikes Volstagg in the face
entities.description: A Frost Giant delivers a powerful blow to Volstagg's face, causing him to fall to one knee.

entities.name: Sif rushes to aid Volstagg
entities.description: Seeing Volstagg in danger, Sif quickly moves toward him to intervene in the fight.

entities.name: Sif uses Volstagg's back to drive blade into Frost Giant
entities.description: Sif leaps onto Volstagg's back and uses her momentum to push his sword deeper into the Frost Giant, killing it.

entities.name: Volstagg thanks Sif while on the ground
entities.description: After being saved, Volstagg expresses gratitude to Sif from the ground, though he claims he almost defeated the Giant himself.

entities.name: Sif deflects barrage of ice bullets with shield
entities.description: A Frost Giant launches a volley of ice projectiles at Sif, who raises her shield in time to block and deflect them.

entities.name: Sif attacks and defeats group of Frost Giants
entities.description: After defending herself, Sif charges into the group of Frost Giants who attacked her and eliminates them.

entities.name: battlefield
entities.description: The physical setting where the ongoing battle between Volstagg, Sif, and the Frost Giants takes place, implied by the context of combat and fallen enemies.

entities.name: Volstagg
entities.description: A warrior fighting against the Frost Giants, who suffers from the necrotizing effects of a Jotun's touch and is aided by Sif during battle.
entities.summary: A large, bearded warrior and member of the Warriors Three, known for his strength, love of food, and loyalty to Thor, expresses awe at powerful artifacts and concern for his comrades while sharing in grand events and battles.

entities.name: Lady Sif
entities.description: A skilled warrior who comes to Volstagg's aid, using his back to drive his blade into a Frost Giant and later defends against an ice bullet barrage.
entities.summary: A warrior woman and companion of Thor, clad in ceremonial armor, participates in key Asgardian events, expressing sentiment toward her weapons, reacting to threats, and investigating disruptions alongside the Warriors Three and Thor.

entities.name: Frost Giant
entities.description: A member of a race of giants made of ice who attacks Volstagg and other warriors, capable of generating ice projectiles and freezing enemies on contact.

entities.name: flask
entities.description: A small container retrieved from a secret compartment in Volstagg's weapon, used by him to drink a pain-relieving substance during battle.

entities.name: blade
entities.description: Volstagg's weapon used to stab a Frost Giant, which becomes stuck in the ice layer of the Giant's body during combat.

entities.name: shield
entities.description: Sif's defensive equipment used to block a barrage of ice bullets fired by a Frost Giant.

entities.name: ice bullets
entities.description: Projectiles formed and hurled by a Frost Giant in an attempt to attack Sif during the battle.

entities.name: weapon
entities.description: Volstagg's primary combat tool containing a secret compartment where he stores a flask.

entities.name: Frost Giant freezes Hogun's feet to the ground
entities.description: A Frost Giant uses his freezing ability to touch a pool of water, causing it to flash-freeze and trap Hogun's feet in ice.

entities.name: Volstagg rushes to free Hogun from ice
entities.description: Volstagg notices Hogun is trapped, fights off Jotuns while hurrying to his ally, and begins hacking at the ice around Hogun's legs with his weapon.

entities.name: Volstagg nearly injures Hogun while breaking ice
entities.description: As Volstagg hacks at the ice binding Hogun, his wild swings cut dangerously close to Hogun's legs, prompting Hogun to warn him to be careful.

entities.name: Volstagg carefully frees Hogun from frozen restraints
entities.description: After nearly harming Hogun, Volstagg adjusts his approach and carefully chips away the ice until Hogun's feet are fully freed.

entities.name: Fandral challenges Frost Giant with sword
entities.description: Fandral engages a Frost Giant in combat, taunting him about the superiority of Asgardian steel over icy weapons before lunging at him.

entities.name: Frost Giant disarms Fandral
entities.description: During combat, the Frost Giant knocks Fandral's sword away and then grabs it, snapping the blade in half.

entities.name: Fandral fights with broken sword
entities.description: After his sword is broken, Fandral continues battling the Frost Giant using only the shattered remains of his weapon.

entities.name: Fandral defeats Frost Giant with own weapon
entities.description: Fandral dodges a lunge from the Frost Giant, seizes the enemy's sword, and redirects it to stab the Giant through with his own weapon.

entities.name: Frost Giant creates ice stalagmite to impale Fandral
entities.description: After being stabbed, a Frost Giant swipes at a pool of water, sending a spray into the air that freezes mid-flight into a sharp ice stalagmite, which impales Fandral.

entities.name: Fandral is impaled and incapacitated by ice stalagmite
entities.description: The ice stalagmite formed by the Frost Giant strikes Fandral, piercing him and leaving him helpless on the battlefield.

entities.name: moments later
entities.description: A short relative temporal reference indicating the immediate progression of events following a prior action in the scene.

entities.name: Hogun
entities.description: A warrior who is frozen in place by a Frost Giant's magic and later freed by Volstagg.
entities.summary: A stoic, brooding warrior of the Warriors Three, loyal to Thor, notices Loki's absence, predicts the banquet's cancellation, and expresses concern over their presence in the Jotun wasteland.

entities.name: Fandral
entities.description: An Asgardian warrior who engages a Frost Giant in combat, loses his sword, and is ultimately impaled by an ice stalagmite.
entities.summary: A charismatic member of the Warriors Three, known for his dashing demeanor and agility, who accompanies Thor and others on missions, expresses concern over legal and dangerous consequences, and makes light-hearted comments in tense situations.

entities.description: A spike of ice formed from frozen water spray, created by a Frost Giant and used to impale Fandral.

entities.description: A body of water on the battlefield that is flash-frozen by a Frost Giant to trap Hogun and later used to create an ice stalagmite.

document_metadata.title: 37、EXT. CENTRAL PLAZA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Thor, realizing his actions endangered his comrades, summons the winds to reach them as they're trapped in icy fog on cracking ice, with Frost Giants advancing.

entities.name: Loki fights through Frost Giants to reach impaled Fandral
entities.description: Loki aggressively advances toward Fandral, throwing daggers and defeating multiple Frost Giants while moving across the battlefield.

entities.name: Volstagg notices Fandral impaled in the plaza
entities.description: Volstagg observes his wounded comrade Fandral stuck on an ice stalagmite from across the plaza, recognizing the severity of the situation.

entities.name: Volstagg rushes to aid wounded Fandral
entities.description: After seeing Fandral in distress, Volstagg moves quickly to assist his injured companion in the battlefield plaza.

entities.name: Volstagg begins extracting Fandral from ice stalagmite
entities.description: Volstagg starts pulling Fandral off the sharp ice formation he is impaled on, attempting to free him while managing his injuries.

entities.name: Loki stabs Frost Giant with dual daggers
entities.description: Loki drives two daggers into the chest of a Frost Giant during combat, incapacitating the enemy.

entities.name: Frost Giant grasps Loki's gloved wrists during combat
entities.description: After being stabbed, a Frost Giant seizes Loki's wrists, trapping the gloves in its grip as Loki pulls away.

entities.name: Loki reveals bare hands by escaping gloves
entities.description: Loki frees himself from the Frost Giant's grasp by slipping his hands out of his gloves, exposing his skin.

entities.name: Frost Giant touches Loki's bare arm and observes transformation
entities.description: A wounded Frost Giant makes contact with Loki's exposed arm, witnessing it turn blue like their own skin without injury.

entities.name: Loki's arm transforms to blue Frost Giant skin
entities.description: Upon contact with the Frost Giant, Loki's arm undergoes a painless transformation, turning blue and resembling Frost Giant physiology.

entities.name: Loki kicks distracted Frost Giant during transformation
entities.description: Taking advantage of the Frost Giant's surprise at Loki's skin transformation, Loki delivers a kick to the stunned enemy.

entities.name: plaza
entities.description: A physical setting where Fandral is impaled on an ice stalagmite and Volstagg notices him, serving as the central scene for the events involving Loki and the Frost Giants.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: A warrior who fights through Frost Giants to reach the impaled Fandral, later revealing a mysterious transformation upon physical contact with a Frost Giant.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Fandral
entities.description: A wounded warrior impaled on an ice stalagmite in the plaza, receiving aid from Volstagg and engaging in brief dialogue about his injuries.
entities.summary: A charismatic member of the Warriors Three, known for his dashing demeanor and agility, who accompanies Thor and others on missions, expresses concern over legal and dangerous consequences, and makes light-hearted comments in tense situations.

entities.name: Volstagg
entities.description: A comrade who notices Fandral's peril in the plaza and rushes to extract him from the ice, engaging in brief banter during the rescue.
entities.summary: A large, bearded warrior and member of the Warriors Three, known for his strength, love of food, and loyalty to Thor, expresses awe at powerful artifacts and concern for his comrades while sharing in grand events and battles.

entities.name: Frost Giant
entities.description: An enemy combatant who engages Loki in battle and discovers Loki's unexpected transformation upon touching his bare skin.

entities.name: Dual Daggers
entities.description: Weapons used by Loki to fight Frost Giants, including stabbing one in the chest and throwing them during combat.
entities.summary: Weapons used by Loki to fight Frost Giants, including stabbing one in the chest and throwing them during combat.

entities.name: gloves
entities.description: Loki's gloves that remain in the Frost Giant's grasp when Loki frees his hands, revealing his bare skin underneath.

entities.name: ice stalagmite
entities.description: A sharp icy formation in the plaza that impales Fandral and must be disengaged during his rescue.

entities.name: Frost Giants
entities.description: A group of enemy combatants engaged in battle with Loki and the Asgardians in the plaza.
entities.summary: Ice giants from Jotunheim, blue-skinned and powerful, are enemies of Asgard, engaged in conflict due to historical grievances and perceived threats of invasion, retreating at Odin's presence.

entities.name: Thor hurls Mjolnir at Frost Giant during combat
entities.description: Thor throws his hammer to strike a Frost Giant, leaving himself temporarily weaponless in the midst of battle.

entities.name: Frost Giants swarm Thor and separate him from Mjolnir
entities.description: Taking advantage of Thor's momentary vulnerability, a group of Frost Giants surround him and prevent him from retrieving his weapon.

entities.name: Mjolnir falls to the ground after failed retrieval by Frost Giant
entities.description: After Thor hurls Mjolnir, it lands on the battlefield where a Frost Giant attempts but fails to lift it, leaving the hammer stranded.

entities.name: Volstagg carries wounded Fandral away from battlefield
entities.description: With Fandral now free from the ice, Volstagg lifts him onto his shoulder and begins retreating with the other warriors.

entities.name: Laufey activates ancient Frost Giant mechanism with energy wave
entities.description: From his balcony, Laufey touches the palace wall, sending an energy wave through the structure that awakens dormant Frost Giant warriors beneath the ice.

entities.name: Dozens of Jotun Warriors awaken beneath the ice surface
entities.description: Responding to Laufey's energy wave, shadowy figures emerge and stir within the ice, revealing a hidden force of Jotun warriors rising to join the battle.

entities.name: Loki urges Thor to retreat from overwhelming Frost Giant forces
entities.description: Seeing the tide of battle turn, Loki approaches Thor and insists they must flee before they are overwhelmed.

entities.name: Thor refuses to retreat despite comrades' warnings
entities.description: Consumed by blood lust, Thor rejects Loki's plea and Sif's concern, declaring he can stop the Frost Giants alone.

entities.name: Frost Giants break through ice and surround Asgardian warriors
entities.description: Newly awakened Frost Giants erupt from beneath the frozen ground, encircling the remaining Asgardians and forcing them into retreat.

entities.name: Asgardian warriors flee toward inner edge of the planet
entities.description: Faced with overwhelming numbers, Volstagg, Sif, and others begin a desperate escape toward the planet's interior, carrying Fandral.

entities.name: Thor is overwhelmed and buried beneath swarm of Frost Giants
entities.description: Despite fighting valiantly, Thor is eventually overtaken by sheer numbers and disappears under a pile of attacking Frost Giants.

entities.name: battlefield
entities.description: The physical setting where the ongoing combat between Asgardians and Frost Giants takes place.

entities.name: palace

entities.name: balcony
entities.description: An elevated platform attached to the palace where Laufey observes the battlefield.

entities.name: Inner Edge Of The Planet
entities.description: A specific geographical boundary on the planet Jotunheim where the Asgardian warriors retreat toward.
entities.summary: A specific geographical boundary on the planet Jotunheim where the Asgardian warriors retreat toward.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: A powerful Asgardian warrior engaged in combat with Frost Giants, driven by blood lust and refusing to retreat despite overwhelming odds.
entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Lady Sif
entities.description: An Asgardian warrior who warns Thor of the growing number of enemies and urges retreat during the battle.
entities.summary: A warrior woman and companion of Thor, clad in ceremonial armor, participates in key Asgardian events, expressing sentiment toward her weapons, reacting to threats, and investigating disruptions alongside the Warriors Three and Thor.

entities.name: Laufey
entities.description: The Frost Giant king who activates an ancient mechanism from the palace balcony to awaken dormant Jotun Warriors beneath the ice.
entities.summary: The Jotun King, ruler of Jotunheim and Loki's biological father, confronts Odin over the Casket of Ancient Winters, accused of breaking their truce while seeking to reclaim it and awaken dormant Frost Giants.

entities.name: Jotuns
entities.description: A group of ancient Frost Giant warriors awakened from beneath the ice to join the battle against the Asgardians.
entities.summary: A group of ancient Frost Giant warriors awakened from beneath the ice to join the battle against the Asgardians.

entities.name: Mjolnir
entities.description: Thor's enchanted hammer, which falls to the ground when he is separated from it during combat with the Frost Giants.
entities.summary: Thor's enchanted hammer, forged from Uru in a dying star, commands lightning and storms, returns when summoned, and moves independently in battle, but falls when he is separated from it.

document_metadata.summary: Odin halts Laufey's attack and repels the Frost Giants with the Bifrost, evacuating Thor and the Asgardians as Laufey watches in contempt.

document_metadata.summary: Odin strips Thor of his powers, title, and armor for his reckless actions, deems him unworthy, and banishes him through the Bifrost, hurling Mjolnir after him with a worthiness enchantment.

document_metadata.title: 62、INT. ODIN'S CHAMBERS - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Frigga reveals Thor's banishment and Loki's new role as Asgard's ruler during Odin's sleep; the Einherjar kneel before him, offering Gungnir, which he accepts, feeling its power.

entities.name: Frigga holds Odin's hand during Odinsleep
entities.description: Frigga sits at Odin's bedside, holding his hand as he undergoes the Odinsleep, a state in which he appears pale and lifeless, his body and surroundings altered by the mystical process.

entities.name: Loki confronts Frigga about Odin's secrecy
entities.description: Loki questions Frigga about why Odin kept the truth from him, expressing emotional conflict over his identity and place in the family while sitting at Odin's bedside.

entities.name: Frigga reassures Loki of his place in the family
entities.description: Frigga tells Loki that he is truly their son and part of their family, emphasizing that Odin withheld the truth to protect him from feeling different.

entities.name: Frigga explains Odin's awareness during Odinsleep
entities.description: Frigga informs Loki that Odin can see and hear them despite his comatose appearance, encouraging Loki to speak to him.

entities.name: Loki expresses unease about Odin's helpless state
entities.description: Loki voices his discomfort at seeing Odin, the most powerful being in the Nine Realms, lying vulnerable and incapacitated during the prolonged Odinsleep.

entities.name: Frigga reveals concern over the duration of Odinsleep
entities.description: Frigga admits she does not know how long the Odinsleep will last this time and expresses fear because they were unprepared for its onset.

entities.name: Loki comforts Frigga with a handhold
entities.description: Loki takes Frigga's hand in a gesture of comfort as she becomes emotional, showing a moment of connection and care between mother and son.

entities.name: Frigga praises Loki as a good son
entities.description: Frigga acknowledges Loki's support during this difficult time, calling him a good son and expressing gratitude for his presence.

entities.name: Frigga urges hope for Odin and Thor's return
entities.description: Frigga tells Loki they must not lose hope that Odin will awaken from the Odinsleep and that Thor will also return to them.

entities.name: Loki shows concern about Thor's fate
entities.description: Loki looks to Frigga with concern and questions what hope there is for Thor's return, indicating his emotional investment in his brother's situation.

entities.name: chamber
entities.description: A confined room where Odin is kept during his Odinsleep, described as being sealed off from daylight and resembling a dark crypt.

entities.name: Frigga
entities.description: The queen and wife of Odin, mother of Thor and Loki, who remains vigilant at Odin's side during his Odinsleep and provides emotional support to her family.
entities.summary: Queen of Asgard, wife of Odin, and mother of Thor and Loki, providing emotional support to her family, guiding her sons, and advocating for reconciliation while maintaining her role beside Odin.

entities.name: Odin Allfather
entities.description: The Allfather and ruler of Asgard, currently in a vulnerable state due to the Odinsleep, during which he is physically weakened but retains awareness.
entities.summary: The Allfather, king of Asgard and father of Thor and Loki, embodies authority and concern over Thor's readiness for kingship, judging his actions and emphasizing responsibility while exhibiting signs of physical decline.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: Son of Frigga and Odin, brother of Thor, who struggles with feelings of insecurity and concern for his family while grappling with Odin's secrecy and condition.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Thor
entities.description: Son of Odin and Frigga, brother of Loki, whose current fate is unknown and a source of concern for his family.
entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Odinsleep
entities.description: A periodic, vulnerable state undergone by Odin that restores his power but leaves his body weakened and isolated, while his consciousness remains active.
entities.summary: A periodic, vulnerable state undergone by Odin that restores his power but leaves his body weakened and isolated, while his consciousness remains active.

entities.name: hand
entities.description: A physical body part used by Frigga and Loki to maintain connection with Odin and each other, symbolizing familial bonds during a time of uncertainty.

entities.name: Loki reacts with concern to Frigga's words about Thor's banishment
entities.description: After Frigga reveals that Thor has been banished and that the line of succession now falls to him, Loki shows visible distress and emotional turmoil.

entities.name: Einherjar Guard blocks Loki's path with armored footsteps
entities.description: As Loki attempts to leave the chamber, the sound of approaching armored footsteps is heard, and the Einherjar Guard enters and blocks his exit.

entities.name: Frigga informs Loki of Thor's banishment and his new role
entities.description: Frigga reveals to Loki that Thor has been banished and that, in Odin's absence, the rule of Asgard now passes to him.

entities.name: Einherjar kneel before Loki in formal allegiance
entities.description: The Einherjar warriors enter the chamber and kneel before Loki, symbolically acknowledging him as the temporary ruler of Asgard.

entities.name: Einherjar presents Gungnir to Loki
entities.description: A second Einherjar warrior enters the chamber carrying Gungnir, kneels before Loki, and formally offers him the royal spear.

entities.name: Loki accepts Gungnir and feels its significance
entities.description: Loki hesitates, then reaches out and takes Gungnir into his hands, visibly responding to the weight and symbolic power of the artifact.

entities.name: Einherjar Guard
entities.description: A member of Asgard's elite warrior guard who blocks Loki's path and later kneels in allegiance.
entities.summary: An Einherjar guard serving in Asgard's elite forces, stationed underground beneath the palace, who reports the Warriors Three and Lady Sif's disappearance to Loki and later pledges allegiance to him.

entities.name: Gungnir
entities.description: A powerful spear symbolizing authority in Asgard, presented to Loki as a sign of his new role.
entities.summary: Odin's spear symbolizes authority, used to defend Asgard, activate the Bifrost, and is later presented to Loki as a sign of his new role, which he holds ceremonially on the throne.

entities.name: Line Of Succession
entities.description: The royal order determining who inherits rule of Asgard in the absence or incapacity of the current monarch.
entities.summary: The royal order determining who inherits rule of Asgard in the absence or incapacity of the current monarch.

document_metadata.title: 63、INT. ISABELA'S DINER - MORNING
document_metadata.summary: Thor learns the satellite crash location from Drunk Townie Jake, becomes excited, and leaves the diner despite warnings of military presence nearby.

entities.name: Thor eats a large breakfast at the diner
entities.description: Thor consumes a massive meal consisting of steak and eggs, pancakes, and biscuits and gravy at a local diner while being observed by Selvig and Darcy.

entities.name: Jane asks Thor to recount his experience from the previous night
entities.description: Jane prompts Thor to describe in detail what happened to him the night before, opening a conversation about his recent experiences.

entities.name: Darcy questions Thor about his appetite
entities.description: Darcy comments on Thor's enormous hunger, noting that he ate an entire box of Pop-Tarts and still appears ravenous.

entities.name: Thor expresses his enjoyment of coffee
entities.description: Thor drinks a cup of coffee and declares his appreciation for it, prompting Darcy to compliment Isabela's coffee-making skills.

entities.name: Thor smashes his coffee mug and demands another
entities.description: After finishing his coffee, Thor throws the empty mug to the ground, shattering it, and calls out loudly for a refill.

entities.name: Isabela Alvarez reacts to the broken mug
entities.description: Isabela, the diner's proprietor, glares at Thor after he breaks the mug and begins venting in Spanish to a waitress about his behavior.

entities.name: Jane apologizes to Isabela for the broken mug
entities.description: Jane apologizes to Isabela in Spanish, offering to pay for the broken mug and attempting to defuse the situation.

entities.name: Jane instructs Thor on polite request behavior
entities.description: Jane explains to Thor that instead of smashing things, he should ask politely for another cup of coffee, teaching him social norms.

entities.name: Thor promises not to smash anything else

document_metadata.title: 116、INT. SHIELD HOLDING CELL - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Loki visits Thor, claiming their father is dead and blames Thor's banishment for it, revealing he now holds the throne while Thor remains exiled, then disappears when Coulson re-enters.

entities.name: Coulson confronts Thor about his combat training background
entities.description: Coulson questions Thor about where he received the specialized training that allowed him to subdue highly-trained agents, suggesting locations like Pakistan, Chechnya, Afghanistan, and South Africa, and implying connections to mercenary work or HYDRA.

entities.name: Thor remains silent during interrogation
entities.description: Thor refuses to respond to Coulson's questions, maintaining silence throughout the interrogation, only speaking once to identify himself as 'just a man' before lowering his head after Coulson leaves.

entities.name: Coulson threatens Thor with forced extraction of information
entities.description: Coulson asserts that S.H.I.E.L.D. will obtain the information they seek regardless of Thor's cooperation, implying the use of coercive methods, before exiting the room.

entities.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Interrogation Session

entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Phil Coulson
entities.description: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent conducting an interrogation of Thor to uncover his combat training origins.

entities.name: Loki informs Thor of Odin's death
entities.description: Loki tells Thor that their father has died, attributing the death to the emotional toll of Thor's banishment and the threat of war.

entities.name: Thor reacts to the news of Odin's death with guilt and sorrow
entities.description: Thor is emotionally devastated upon learning of Odin's death, internalizing responsibility for his father's fate.

entities.name: Loki consoles Thor about Odin's death
entities.description: Loki comforts Thor, telling him not to blame himself and affirming that Odin knew of Thor's love.

entities.name: Loki reveals he has assumed the throne of Asgard
entities.description: Loki informs Thor that, due to the circumstances, the responsibility of ruling Asgard now falls to him.

entities.name: Thor asks Loki if he can return home
entities.description: Thor pleads with Loki for a way to end his exile and return to Asgard, showing his desire for reconciliation.

entities.name: Loki denies Thor's return due to truce conditions and Frigga's decree
entities.description: Loki explains that Thor's exile is required by the truce with Jotunheim and that their mother has forbidden his return.

entities.name: Loki bids farewell to Thor
entities.description: Loki emotionally says goodbye to Thor, expressing sorrow over their separation and affirming his love for his brother.

entities.name: Thor expresses gratitude to Loki for visiting
entities.description: Thor thanks Loki for coming to see him in his imprisoned state, acknowledging the significance of the visit.

entities.name: Loki vanishes from the interrogation room
entities.description: After the emotional exchange, Loki disappears from the room, leaving no trace of his presence.

entities.description: Coulson returns to the interrogation room and resumes questioning Thor, seemingly unaware of Loki's presence.

entities.description: Thor looks around in confusion after Coulson speaks, realizing that Loki has vanished and the conversation may not have been witnessed.

entities.name: Jotunheim

entities.summary: Thor, the Asgardian god of thunder and prince, son of Odin and Frigga, prepares for his coronation amid sibling tension with Loki, displaying both dignity and anxiety while engaging in ceremonial duties and verbal conflict.

entities.name: Loki
entities.description: A cunning Asgardian prince who intends to use the Bifrost as a weapon to destroy Jotunheim and prove his worth to their father.
entities.summary: Loki, the cunning and sarcastic prince of Asgard, brother of Thor, uses magic and illusions while navigating royal duties, expressing concern for Thor's actions and engaging in complex emotional and strategic interactions.

entities.name: Gungnir
entities.description: A powerful spear wielded by Loki, capable of firing energy blasts and used in combat against Thor.
entities.summary: Odin's spear symbolizes authority, used to defend Asgard, activate the Bifrost, and is later presented to Loki as a sign of his new role, which he holds ceremonially on the throne.

entities.name: Mjolnir
entities.description: Thor's enchanted hammer, which he raises to break the ice covering the Bifrost controls and prepares to use in defense.
entities.summary: Thor's enchanted hammer, forged from Uru in a dying star, commands lightning and storms, returns when summoned, and moves independently in battle, but falls when he is separated from it.

entities.name: Asgard
entities.summary: Asgard is the realm and capital city of the Asgardians, serving as the origin and authority for its characters, and the setting for key events such as royal ceremonies, from which Thor and companions depart through the Gate.

entities.name: Frost Giants
entities.description: A race of ice giants native to Jotunheim, long-standing enemies of Asgard and the target of Loki's genocidal plan.
entities.summary: Ice giants from Jotunheim, blue-skinned and powerful, are enemies of Asgard, engaged in conflict due to historical grievances and perceived threats of invasion, retreating at Odin's presence.

entities.name: Loki fires Gungnir at Thor, immobilizing him in the air
entities.description: Loki spins, aims Gungnir, and releases a powerful energy blast that strikes Thor, suspending him motionless in midair.

entities.name: Thor questions Loki's motives regarding the throne and his transformation
entities.description: While suspended in the air, Thor challenges Loki, asking if the throne is truly worth his actions and the person he has become.

entities.name: Loki declares he never wanted the throne but desired equality with Thor
entities.description: Loki responds to Thor's question by stating he never sought the throne, only to be seen as Thor's equal, then demands Thor fight him.

entities.name: Loki uses Gungnir to hurl Thor to the ground
entities.description: With a gesture of Gungnir, Loki propels Thor forcefully through the air and slams him into the ground.

entities.name: Thor rises and refuses to fight Loki
entities.description: After being thrown to the ground, Thor stands, turns to Loki, and declares he will not fight his brother.

entities.name: Loki rejects his bond with Thor, denying their brotherhood
entities.description: Loki coldly tells Thor that he is not his brother and never was, severing their familial connection.

entities.name: Thor calls Loki's actions madness
entities.description: Thor expresses disbelief at Loki's behavior, calling his actions and mindset insane.

entities.name: Loki fires Gungnir at Thor again, prompting Thor to dodge and roll to his feet
entities.description: Loki unleashes another blast from Gungnir, which Thor narrowly avoids by dodging and quickly regaining his footing.

entities.name: Loki mocks Thor for becoming soft due to his time on Earth
entities.description: Loki taunts Thor, questioning what changed him on Earth and sarcastically suggesting a woman made him weak.

entities.name: Loki realizes Thor's feelings for a woman on Earth and threatens to visit her
entities.description: Upon Thor's silence, Loki deduces he is correct about the woman and menacingly suggests he will pay her a visit after their fight.

entities.name: Loki and Thor charge at each other and begin fighting
entities.description: Provoked by Loki's threat, Thor and Loki rush forward and engage in combat, their weapons clashing as the battle begins.

entities.name: Loki and Thor battle with intense emotional conflict
entities.description: The two brothers fight fiercely—Loki driven by years of repressed rage and jealousy, Thor forced into defense without desire to harm.

entities.name: Volstagg recounts battle with the Destroyer

entities.description: Fandral interrupts Volstagg's story to sarcastically suggest that 'flying at the beast' was actually falling on his backside.

entities.description: Hogun silently points to Volstagg and says 'Big stomach,' then points to Fandral and says 'Big mouth,' prompting laughter from the group.

entities.description: After his joke, the typically grim Hogun shows a faint smile, surprising Fandral and the others.

entities.name: Fandral proposes celebratory toast
entities.description: Fandral declares Hogun's smile worthy of another round of drinks and raises his cup, prompting shared laughter and drinking among the group.
